stories.title: Water supplies affected in Flint, Bagillt and Gronant on Saturday evening
stories.summary: Homes in parts of Flint and Bagillt may have no water or low pressure this evening, Welsh Water has said. The water company is dealing with a supply problem in Oakenholt and surrounding areas of Flint, and a burst water main affecting Foel Gron in Bagillt. stories.title: First designs for Buckley town centre revamp to go on show at precinct drop-in
stories.summary: The first concept designs for a revamp of Buckley town centre will go on show in Buckley Precinct on Thursday 12 November. stories.title: About three million self-assessment taxpayers to move to regular in-year tax payments
stories.summary: About three million self-assessment taxpayers will pay their income tax in smaller, more regular instalments during the year from April 2029, HMRC has confirmed. The change replaces the twice-yearly payments on account, due on 31 January and 31 July, which self-employed people and landlords have made for around 30 years. The government confirmed the move

stories.title: Broughton: SP Energy Networks says power has been restored
stories.summary: Part of Broughton is without power this morning after an unplanned power cut, with SP Energy Networks aiming to restore supplies by 2.40pm.

stories.title: Two drink drivers caught and two held on suspicion of oil theft in south Flintshire
stories.summary: Two drink drivers were caught and two people were taken into custody on suspicion of theft during one overnight shift by police in south Flintshire.
